segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: So I hope it's clear.
segments.zh: 所以我希望它很清楚。

segments.en: It does sound a little bit complicated, but this is what our website is for, right?
segments.zh: 听起来确实有点复杂，但这就是我们的网站的用途，对吧？

segments.en: So if you have questions or doubts or you want to try and plant your own ideas, you can come to the website and do it.
segments.zh: 因此，如果您有疑问或疑问，或者您想尝试植入自己的想法，您可以访问该网站并做到这一点。

segments.en: Want to make some of your own sentences and practice some of these new things, then come to our website, post some comments and we are happy to correct and add our own commentary on those.
segments.zh: 想写一些你自己的句子并练习一些这些新事物，然后访问我们的网站，发表一些评论，我们很乐意纠正并添加我们自己的评论。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So before we go, let's listen to this dialogue one last time.
segments.zh: 所以在我们走之前，让我们最后一次听听这场对话。

segments.en: This is the good life.
segments.zh: 这是美好的生活。

segments.en: You have it good, don't you think?
segments.zh: 你有很好的，你不觉得吗？

segments.en: Yeah, of course.
segments.zh: 对，当然。

segments.en: Although, don't you ever wonder what could have been?
segments.zh: 不过，你难道从没想过，如果当初做了别的选择，现在会怎样吗？

segments.en: What do you mean?
segments.zh: 你是什么意思？

segments.en: Well, sometimes I think of how things could have turned out if I had done things a little differently.
segments.zh: 好吧，有时我会想到如果我做的事情有点不同，事情会变成什么样子。

segments.en: For example?
segments.zh: 比如呢？

segments.en: Like, for example, if I hadn't studied architecture, I would have become an artist like I wanted to.
segments.zh: 例如，如果我没有学习建筑，我会成为我想要的艺术家。

segments.en: I see.
segments.zh: 我明白了。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Now that I think of it, I wouldn't have gotten married if I hadn't moved to this town and met Sally.
segments.zh: 现在想起来，如果我没有搬到这个小镇遇到莎莉，我就不会结婚了。

segments.en: You see, everything happens for a reason.
segments.zh: 你看，每件事的发生都有原因。

segments.en: We wouldn't even have met if I hadn't been in that car accident 10 years ago.
segments.zh: 如果我在 10 年前没有发生过那次车祸，我们甚至不会见面。

segments.en: Well, I have no regrets.
segments.zh: 好吧，我没有遗憾。

segments.en: I'll drink to that.
segments.zh: 我为此干杯。

segments.en: All right, we're back.
segments.zh: 好了，我们回来了。

segments.en: So, Catherine, any other regrets maybe in your life apart from opening your mouth?
segments.zh: 那么，凯瑟琳，除了张开嘴之外，你的生活中还有什么遗憾吗？

segments.en: Any other regrets?
segments.zh: 还有其他遗憾吗？

segments.en: If my parents had spoken Spanish to me as a kid, I would have learned.
segments.zh: 如果我的父母小时候对我说西班牙语，我会学到的。

segments.en: But instead, I just learned English and that's all.
segments.zh: 但相反，我只是学了英语，仅此而已。

segments.en: Well, your mom is half Swedish, right?
segments.zh: 好吧，你妈妈是一半瑞典人，对吧？

segments.en: Half Swedish, half Czech.
segments.zh: 一半瑞典语，一半捷克语。

segments.en: And she never spoke any of these languages to you?
segments.zh: 她从来没有和你说过这些语言吗？

segments.en: No, she didn't speak Swedish or Czech.
segments.zh: 不，她不会说瑞典语或捷克语。

segments.en: Her parents spoke English as their common language, but she grew up speaking Italian and German.
segments.zh: 她的父母说英语是他们的共同语言，但她从小就说意大利语和德语。

segments.en: But she didn't speak to me in those languages.
segments.zh: 但她没有用那些语言和我说话。

segments.en: And then as an adult, she forgot some of them.
segments.zh: 然后作为一个成年人，她忘记了其中的一些。

segments.en: And so, because my dad was, well, they're both Americans now, but my dad's American.
segments.zh: 所以，因为我父亲是，嗯，他们现在都是美国人，但我父亲是美国人。

segments.en: They just spoke English to me.
segments.zh: 他们只是对我说英语。

segments.en: Wow.
segments.zh: 哇。

segments.en: But now you speak Italian.
segments.zh: 但现在你会说意大利语。

segments.en: So, do you ever try and talk to your mom in Italian?
segments.zh: 那么，你有没有试过用意大利语和你妈妈说话？

segments.en: Sometimes.
segments.zh: 有时候。

segments.en: My grandmother's Italian is much better.
segments.zh: 我祖母的意大利语要好得多。

segments.en: So, my grandmother is completely fluent.
segments.zh: 所以，我的祖母是完全流利的。

segments.en: So I speak to her in Italian and German as well.
segments.zh: 所以我也用意大利语和德语和她说话。

segments.en: She's fluent in German too.
segments.zh: 她也能说一口流利的德语。

segments.en: And I studied German at school.
segments.zh: 我在学校学习德语。

segments.en: See, this is the interesting thing now.
segments.zh: 看，这是现在有趣的事情。

segments.en: So many people are speaking so many languages.
segments.zh: 这么多人说的是很多语言。

segments.en: Even before, if you spoke another foreign language, it was a big deal.
segments.zh: 甚至在之前，如果你说另一种外语，那是一件大事。

segments.en: Oh yeah.
segments.zh: 哦，对。

segments.en: But now it's like a requirement.
segments.zh: 但现在它就像一个要求。

segments.en: You have to at least dominate your own native language and a foreign language, right?
segments.zh: 你至少必须支配你自己的母语和外语，对吧？

segments.en: So, if your native language is English, you at least have to speak Spanish or Chinese or some other language.
segments.zh: 因此，如果您的母语是英语，您至少必须说西班牙语或中文或其他语言。

segments.en: Definitely true.
segments.zh: 绝对是真的。

segments.en: And I think there are a lot of people, a lot of our users that speak maybe two or three languages and English is just one more.
segments.zh: 而且我认为有很多人，我们的很多用户可能会说两种或三种语言，而英语只是另一种。

segments.en: So, you know, more power to them.
segments.zh: 所以，你知道，对他们来说更多的力量。

segments.en: This is a really great skill to have and I think it's really important to keep on going with it even though it's frustrating sometimes.
segments.zh: 这是一项非常棒的技能，我认为继续使用它非常重要，即使它有时令人沮丧。

segments.en: And actually, once you've been able, and actually once you mastered two or three different languages, then the fourth and fifth just becomes easier.
segments.zh: 实际上，一旦你能够，并且实际上一旦你掌握了两种或三种不同的语言，那么第四个和第五种语言就会变得更容易。

segments.en: Actually it's true.
segments.zh: 其实这是真的。

segments.en: It sounds funny when you hear it because you're like, how could it be easier to learn more?
segments.zh: 当你听到它时，这听起来很有趣，因为你喜欢，怎么能更容易了解更多？

segments.en: But your brain starts to understand patterns better, right?
segments.zh: 但是你的大脑开始更好地理解模式，对吧？

segments.en: And so it just becomes more natural for you.
segments.zh: 所以它对你来说变得更加自然。

segments.en: It just picks up patterns from the two or three other different languages that you dominate.
segments.zh: 它只是从您主导的两种或三种其他不同语言中获取模式。

segments.en: So it's a weird, it's strange how the brain works.
segments.zh: 所以这很奇怪，大脑的工作方式很奇怪。

segments.en: You make connections.
segments.zh: 你建立联系。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: All right, guys.
segments.zh: 好了，各位。

segments.en: So that's all for today.
segments.zh: 所以这就是今天的全部内容。

segments.en: Be sure to visit our website EnglishPod.com.
segments.zh: 请务必访问我们的网站 englishpod.com。

segments.en: As we said, any questions or comments or you want us to correct your grammar of this lesson, you can visit us there and we'll see you guys next time.
segments.zh: 正如我们所说，任何问题或意见，或者您希望我们更正您对本课的语法，您可以访问我们，我们下次再见。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Bye everyone.
segments.zh: 大家再见。

segments.en: Bye.
segments.zh: 再见。
